title: A focused software quality assurance profile.
description: I’m Kiran Dhakal, a QA/SQA engineer in Kathmandu focused on software testing, defect analysis, API validation, and dependable releases.

sections.title: QA focus
paragraphs: My CV is now positioned for QA/SQA roles: manual testing, exploratory testing, test case design, API checks, data validation, defect reporting, and regression planning.
I focus on whether a feature behaves correctly for the user, protects data, handles edge cases, and leaves enough evidence for a confident release decision.

sections.title: Information Care Pvt. Ltd.
paragraphs: The product domains in my CV include Dhangadhi Service Bus, Hello Palika, Vibe College, CTF School Management, Chiurika, Connect Kisan, Syanko POS, and Dwarika Engineering. They give me practical QA context around workflows, forms, notifications, payments, reporting, and responsive user interfaces.

sections.title: Education & interests
paragraphs: Bachelor of Computer Engineering, Gandaki College of Engineering and Science, Pokhara — 2020–2025, as listed in my CV.
I speak Nepali, English, and Hindi. I enjoy strategic chess, learning testing tools, writing better bug reports, and studying how real users move through software.
